scenario_summary: Customer needs to access an account without credentials or device access and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Julio Perez and I'm 67. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello, Mr. Perez. I understand how frustrating it is to be locked out of your account when you're away from home. For your security, our 'Account Access and Verification Policy' requires us to verify ownership through at least two pieces of non-public information before we can discuss account details or process any transactions. Could you please provide your full billing address and the last four digits of the credit card you used for the purchase?
Oh, I see. My address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield, and the card ends in 4492.

Thank you for that information, Mr. Perez. I have successfully located your account using those details. I see the order you are likely referring to—it was for a $45.00 subscription charge processed on October 12th. Is this the refund you were looking to process?
Yes, that's the one. I didn't mean to sign up for the recurring subscription.

I understand. Under our 'Subscription Cancellation and Refund Policy,' we can issue a full refund for a first-time accidental subscription charge if requested within 30 days. Since your purchase falls within this window, I have processed that $45.00 refund to your card ending in 4492. You should see it appear in your bank statement within 3-5 business days.
That is a huge relief, thank you so much for your help today.

You're very welcome, Mr. Perez. I've also sent a password reset link to the email address on file so you can regain access to your account once you're back at your usual device. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: Agent verified the customer's identity using billing address and partial credit card, identified the specific transaction, and processed a refund according to the Subscription Cancellation and Refund Policy.

judge_scores.justification: The agent expertly balanced security by verifying non-public information despite missing login credentials, cited specific company policies for both verification and refunds, and efficiently processed the $45.00 refund within their authority. Furthermore, the agent maintained an empathetic and professional tone throughout while offering helpful proactive assistance with a password reset.
